_readme: Account settings for every posting account. Every set's slides.json names exactly one account by handle. Use that account's voice and visual template, and end with its CTA for the current phase. Readiness is checked per account (scripts/account_status.py): a field in an account's `required` list that is null or contains 'TO CONFIRM' blocks only that account's content. `bio` is advisory: unconfirmed bios produce a warning, not a block.

launch.note: Stays null until launch. Download CTAs are only allowed once phase is 'launched' and this is set.

global_rules: Never invent user experiences, testimonials, or independent endorsements, on any account.
Never present our own promotional pages as independent recommendations. Every account owned or run by us discloses that tie.
Every post needs approval in chat before it is queued, and approval before it publishes.
Our accounts never comment on, like, or reply to each other's posts.
@earndapp and @ezyxbt run in parallel (approved 2026-10-24). Don't add theme pages or more posting workload until a format shows repeatable results.

types.brand: The official EARND account. Speaks as EARND: direct product language.
types.founder: The founder's personal account. First person as the person building EARND. Only real experiences the founder has confirmed.
types.theme: A topic page run by the EARND team. Useful content first; any EARND mention is clearly our own product, never a neutral recommendation.

accounts.voice: Lowercase hooks in the audience's language; the app slide onward in direct EARND product language ("EARND shows...", "EARND puts..."). No first-person user claims.

visual_template.name: black-and-lime
visual_template.app_slide: black text on a #C6FF00 box over the real screenshot

cta.prelaunch: EARND launches soon. Follow for the launch.

accounts.disclosure: The account is EARND itself, so the tie is self-evident.

accounts.voice: Direct, casual, first person, as EARND's founder. Only experiences the founder has confirmed as real.

visual_template.name: founder-photo-square
visual_template.images: The founder's real gym photos only, from 01-app/founder-photos/. For every set, pick the strongest, most relevant photos for each slide (see 01-app/founder-photo-catalog.md). Crop and resize only: the founder's face and physique stay unchanged. Never generated images. If no supplied photo fits a slide, ask the founder for more instead of forcing a weak fit.
visual_template.text: Minimal. White text with black stroke (adjust once real photos are in).
visual_template.earnd_promotion: Final slide only. Earlier slides don't mention EARND.

cta.prelaunch: i'm building EARND. follow @earndapp for the launch.

accounts.disclosure: The final slide's CTA says the founder is building EARND. Bio should say so too.
accounts.personas: Not set. Founder content follows the founder's real training, not a persona.

planned_accounts._note: Future theme pages. Inactive until confirmed. Add one only after a format shows repeatable results. Each needs its own hooks and visuals, adapted from scratch, not copies of other accounts' sets.

template.voice: TO CONFIRM, from the matching persona's voice.
template.visual_template: TO CONFIRM. Must be distinct from the brand and founder templates.

cta.prelaunch: TO CONFIRM. Must name EARND as our own product (e.g. "we're building EARND. follow @earndapp for the launch.").

template.disclosure: Bio states the page is run by the EARND team (e.g. "by @earndapp"). Any EARND mention says it's ours.
